Lower bitrate when frames are lost
Off: Lower bitrate when the network is busy applies. On: this device adjusts from frame loss and network delay.
Turns the bitrate down as soon as frames go missing and back up after clean seconds, in place of “Lower bitrate when the network is busy”. Needs PC support.
